top_signals.title: Chinese Oil Giant Launches World-First 16MW Floating Wind Turbine
top_signals.summary: State-owned China National Offshore Oil Corporation (CNOOC) on Thursday announced the start of operations of the world's first 16-megawatt tension-leg platform (TLP) floating wind power platform, which began supplying power to an offshore oilfield. CNOOC, one of the biggest oil producers in China and a specialist in offshore technology, connected the Haiyou Anlan floating wind power platform to the Lufeng Oilfield grid via a 4.3-kilometer-long (2.7 miles) subsea cable, the company said in a statement carried by Chinese media. top_signals.title: MercadoLibre Drops as E-Commerce Giant Signals More Spending
top_signals.summary: MercadoLibre Inc. shares slid as analysts signaled worries about the e-commerce giant’s spending plans despite it reporting sales and profits that beat consensus estimates in the second quarter.

top_signals.title: ‘Sell America’ Debate Re-Emerges as US Policy Sows Doubt
top_signals.summary:
Global bond and currency investors are debating if it’s time to dust off last year’s ‘Sell America’ trade after a flurry of economic-policy decisions out of Washington over the past two weeks.
Julia Hermann, Director: Global Market Strategy at New York Life Investment Management, discusses tightening economic conditions, the pass through to equities, and a resurgence in the 'sell America' trade. (Source: Bloomberg)
